data.desc: Fortuna Mining Corp. is a Canadian precious metals mining company with three operating mines in Argentina, Cote d'Ivoire, and Peru, and the feasibility-stage Diamba Sud Gold Project located in Senegal. Our exploration portfolio spans our operating jurisdictions as well as Guinea and Guyana. Sustainability is the core of our operations and stakeholder relationships. We produce gold and silver while creating a long-term shared value through efficient production, environmental stewardship, and social responsibility.
